style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a thick, heavy corporate service contract bound in dark textured cardstock, resting on a plain dark matte desk surface. A single, small copper coin sits isolated on the massive document, symbolizing a tiny fractional payout. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight casting soft contact shadows. One page is slightly out of alignment to look handled. Muted paper tones, sophisticated editorial color palette, razor-sharp focus on the metallic coin and the heavy paper grain, generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, bare geometry, abstract scraps, people, hands, pens, generic paper sheets.
rationale: This contractual story revolves around the gap between an SLA's written promise and its actual financial payout. A document flatlay with a stark contrast in scale perfectly captures the administrative reality of a refund schedule.
subject: a thick service contract and a single small coin
alt_text: Overhead view of a thick, dark-bound service contract with a single small copper coin resting on top.
caption: Cloud uptime promises are structured as vendor refund schedules rather than true insurance policies.
title: cloud-sla-refund-contract
